Definition: of uncertain affinity; to vomit:--(will) spue.
BiblicalUsage: It is a blunt word: to vomit. Christ turns it on the lukewarm church at Laodicea in Revelation 3:16, saying He will spue them out of His mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is meant to shock us awake — a faith that is neither hot nor cold is not safe, it is sickening to the Lord.
RelatedEvents: The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
